name: test-layout-shape
body: Layout contract: every source module with tests gets a sibling `src/<module>/tests.rs` reached by `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`; every module's e2e tests get a top-level `tests/<module>_e2e.rs` crate; shared fixtures live in exactly one place (`tests/common/mod.rs`, plus the library's `testutil`), never duplicated per tier; non-test helpers stay at the test-module root, never inside a `unit`/`int`/`e2e` submodule.
